entities.name: Brivaracetam
observations: At 100–300 μM, reduced peak voltage-gated Na+ current by approximately 30% in N1E-115 cells and 21% in cultured rat cortical neurons; no detectable effect in adult mouse CA1 neurons under study conditions.
Modulated fast inactivation, including a hyperpolarizing shift of half-inactivation voltage in N1E-115 cells.
Did not impair sustained repetitive firing in cultured cortical or adult mouse CA1 neurons.

entities.name: Carbamazepine
observations: At 100 μM, reduced peak voltage-gated Na+ current by approximately 40% in N1E-115 cells and 47% in cultured cortical neurons.
Inhibited sustained repetitive firing by approximately 75–93% in the comparative assays.

entities.name: PMID:25444522
observations: Margineanu et al. reported that brivaracetam differentially affects voltage-gated sodium currents without impairing sustained repetitive firing in neurons.

The study examined N1E-115 neuroblastoma cells, cultured rat cortical neurons, and adult mouse CA1 neurons; dedicated persistent, resurgent, or molecularly resolved NaV-subtype experiments were not reported.
